headline: Public hearings on variance requests for 48 Buckmeadow Road and 20 Canal Street properties.
summary: The board will hear a variance request from Miguel Bisono for 48 Buckmeadow Road covering land area, open space, number of structures, and driveway width. It will also hear a variance request from Anand Mahendrakar for 20 Canal Street covering minimum land area.
items: Public hearing: Miguel Bisono, 48 Buckmeadow Road (Sheet C Lot 216), variances for minimum land area (67,949 sqft existing, 160,000 sqft required for 4 dwellings), minimum open space (75% required, 66% proposed), more than 1 principal structure on a lot (4 proposed), and cumulative driveway width (24 feet permitted, 41 feet proposed across 2 driveways). R40 Zone, Ward 5.

Public hearing: Anand Mahendrakar (Applicant), Blue Coral Canal LLC (Owner), 20 Canal Street (Sheet 42 Lot 72), variance for minimum land area (10,308 sqft existing, 52,272 sqft required for 6 dwellings). LB Zone, Ward 3.
Review of upcoming agenda to determine proposals of regional impact.
location: 3rd floor auditorium, Nashua City Hall, 229 Main St, Nashua, NH

The following is to be published on ROP October 18, 2026 under

Notice is hereby given that a Public Hearing of the City of Nashua

Hall, 229 Main St, Nashua, NH. Members of the public can submit 
their comments via email to (zb@nashuanh.gov) or by mail (please 
make sure to include your name/address and comments) by 4:00 p.m. 
on October 26, 2026. Letters should be addressed to City of 
Nashua, Planning Department, P.O. Box 2019, Nashua, NH 03061. 
Plans can be viewed online starting October 20, 2026 , at 
www.nashuanh.gov.
